name: Small Healing Potion 10ea Box
desc: A box containing 10 Small Healing Potion. When consumed, restores 5% of MHP every 5 seconds for 30 minutes. The effect does not activate while in Frenzy state. The item effect disappears if the character becomes incapacitated. Cannot be used during WoE, and the effect will not activate. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for cancellation and refund.

name: Zelstar 4ea Box
desc: A box containing 4 Zelstar. A gem formed when Jellopy dropped by monsters was buried underground, exposed to extreme pressure and heat for tens of thousands of years, and fossilized. Can be used in various ways, including World Transportation Service and the Refinery (Mineral Synthesis). Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for cancellation and refund.

name: Costume Unbinding Injection Box
desc: Box containing 1 [Costume] Unbinding Injector. Can be used by talking to the Costume Unbinder NPC (prontera 251 267). By consuming 1 '[Costume] Unbinding Injector' +1 'Bound Costume', it can be exchanged for 1 'Costume'. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for refund.

name: Kafra Storage Bell Box - 7 Days
desc: A box containing 1 Kafra Storage Bell usable for 7 days. Shake it anywhere to have a Kafra Employee open Storage. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for cancellation and refund.

name: Tool Dealer Summon Bell Box - 7 Days
desc: A box containing 1 Merchant Call Bell usable for 7 days. With this, Tool Dealer can be called anywhere to buy useful consumables or sell items being carried. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for cancellation and refund.

name: Life Insurance 10ea Box
desc: A box containing 10 Life Insurance Certificate. For those preparing for the unexpected. But do not get hurt on purpose. Life Insurance Certificate - For 30 minutes after use, no EXP is lost on death. The effect ends after one death. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for cancellation and refund.

name: Account Death Penalty Buff Box - 7 Days
desc: [Usage Period] 7 days after item use [Applies To] All characters on the server of the character that used the item Contains a potion that grants the following effects to all characters on the server for 7 days. - Death penalty -50% Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for cancellation and refund.

desc: [Usage Period] 7 days after item use [Applies To] All characters on the server of the character that used the item Contains a potion that grants the following effects to all characters on the server for 7 days. - Item drop rate +10% Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for cancellation and refund.

name: Agi Up Potion 10ea Box
desc: A box containing 10 Agi Up Potion. A potion that produces an even greater effect when used with other ASPD-boosting potions. When consumed, ASPD increases slightly more for 30 minutes. Applies the same way as existing ASPD potions, and the amount of ASPD gained may vary depending on AGI. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for refund.

name: Ale's Blessing 10ea Box
desc: A box containing 10 Ale's Blessing. A potion containing the blessing known as Ale's Blessing, bestowed by the god of herbs. For 30 minutes, incoming Heal and the effectiveness of certain recovery items used increase by 20%. The item effect disappears if the character becomes incapacitated. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for refund.

name: Challenge Drink 10ea Box
desc: A box containing 10 Challenge Drink. A drink that activates internal energy and greatly enhances ability. For 30 minutes, ATK/MATK +30, ATK/MATK +1%, HIT/FLEE +30, ASPD +1, SP consumption -5%, fixed casting time -30%. (% modifiers to fixed casting do not stack. Only the largest effect applies.) The item effect disappears if the character becomes incapacitated. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for refund.

name: Enriched Abrasive 10ea Box
desc: A box containing 10 Concentrated Polishing Agent. A Polishing Agent that sharpens Weapon. Apply to Weapon to increase CRIT by 30 for 30 minutes. The item effect disappears if the character becomes incapacitated. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for refund.

name: Megaphone 10ea Box
desc: A box containing 10 Megaphone. It seems to be a miniature megaphone. Megaphone - Broadcasts the entered message to the entire server. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for cancellation and refund.

name: Mimir's Well 10ea Box
desc: A box containing 10 Mimir's Well. Water drawn from the spring of wisdom known as the spring of Mimir. For 30 minutes, MSP +10%, SP consumption -10%. (When buffs with the same effect are stacked, only the most recently used effect is applied.) The item effect disappears if the character becomes incapacitated. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for refund.

name: Premium Course Meal Box
desc: A box containing 10 Premium Course Meal. A Premium dish made by condensing all dishes reputed to be good for the body. For 30 minutes, All Stats +10, ATK +30, MATK +30. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for refund.

name: Unlimited Drink 10ea Box
desc: A box containing 10 Unlimited Drink. A drink that activates internal energy, briefly surging with what feels like limitless power. For 30 minutes, MHP/MSP +5%. Critical Damage/ranged physical damage/all property magic damage +5%. Casting cannot be interrupted. The item effect disappears if the character becomes incapacitated. Once this item is opened, it becomes ineligible for refund.
